description: Known manufacturer firmware bugs for mfr+pid pairs already present in our drivers. type=runtime rules are applied by lib/quirks/FirmwareQuirks.js; status=existing points to code that already handles it; status=documented is tracked only (not applied). enabled=false means the runtime workaround exists but is parked until a second source or user confirmation.

quirks.bug: DP1 presence is inverted: 0 = person present, 1 = clear (looks like presence stuck YES when the room is empty)
quirks.workaround: invert DP1 before the presence pipeline (pair-scoped)

quirks.bug: firmware leaves the network after ~10 minutes without Basic-cluster keep-alive reads
quirks.workaround: read genBasic.appVersion every 120 s while the device is initialised (pair-scoped)

quirks.bug: firmware periodically reports move/presence sensitivity (DP2/DP102) as 0 although a valid value is stored
quirks.workaround: drop DP2/DP102 value 0 via FirmwareQuirks.shouldDropDp so Homey settings are not overwritten

quirks.bug: ZY-M100-24GV3 firmware emits numeric 0 reports in loops
quirks.workaround: drop 0-valued non-bool DP reports for this mfr

quirks.bug: DP1 sticks at present while distance is 0 m
quirks.workaround: DP1 marked unreliable + clear presence on zero distance + soft-clear watchdog

quirks.bug: replies UNSUPPORTED_ATTRIBUTE to the magic packet / tuyaOperationMode access
quirks.workaround: operating-mode setup is wrapped in try/catch; device keeps working

quirks.bug: with periodic genOnOff/genLevelCtrl reporting (max 3600 s) the firmware sends a stale hourly report (onOff=1, frozen level)
quirks.workaround: our drivers never configure periodic genOnOff/genLevelCtrl reporting for these pairs (only activePower on dimmer_wall_1gang); guarded by test/critical/p2790-firmware-quirk-workarounds.test.js

quirks.bug: MCU only accepts a Unix-epoch (1970) mcuSyncTime answer; Tuya-2000 epoch or no answer freezes sensor reporting after reboot
quirks.workaround: time sync answers with the Unix 1970 epoch by default; this pair is not in the epoch-2000 list (TuyaSpecificCluster.needsEpoch2000 = false), guarded by test. Driver placement still needs a device diagnostic

quirks.bug: preset enum differs from siblings (auto=1, manual=0, temporary_manual=2)
quirks.workaround: not applied: the preset DP number for these pairs in our wall_thermostat layout is unconfirmed (never guess a DP); generic enum remap (type enum_remap, params {dp, map}) is available in FirmwareQuirks.transformDp once a diagnostic gives the DP

quirks.bug: PIR+lux unit reported with inverted presence semantics (0/1) and illuminance on DP101; battery DP unknown
quirks.workaround: implemented, parked (enabled=false): invert DP1 before the presence pipeline, pair-scoped (same mechanism as iadro9bf)
quirks.enableWhen: second independent source or a Homey diagnostic confirming DP1 polarity

quirks.bug: values arrive as Tuya data response (0x02) as well as report; DP2 humidity is not x10 on this variant
quirks.workaround: listen to both report and response; DP2 humidity used as-is (direct humidity list)

quirks.bug: soil sensor reports DP5 temperature in 0.1 °C; runtimes that read it as whole °C show 10x values (also sends data as response frames, and compound frames)
quirks.workaround: DP5 /10, DP3 soil moisture, DP15 battery; accept both report and response frames

quirks.bug: an every-other-frame debounce makes presses need repeating on newer Homey hardware, while other reports show an OFF->ON double toggle: the frame multiplicity differs from sibling remotes
quirks.workaround: pair-scoped: drop an identical button+pressType repeated within 500 ms (TS0044 only; the TS0042 couple is unaffected). No alternate-frame drop, so real presses are never skipped; parked (P2791): physical Homey testing reports one usable frame per action, so a dedupe window could drop quick presses
quirks.enableWhen: a Homey diagnostic showing duplicate frames per press for this couple (physical Homey testing found one usable frame per action)

quirks.bug: a virtual (app) press on one gang toggles all physical gangs (group-addressed command reaches every endpoint)
quirks.workaround: pair-scoped: after an app command on one gang, if EVERY other gang flipped to the same value within 1.5 s, re-send their previous state (per-endpoint unicast)

quirks.bug: single click not reported in scene mode; a later press (even 20 s apart) is seen as a double click
quirks.workaround: pair-scoped: genOnOff commandOn AND commandOff both mean one single press (toggle firmware alternates them), so no press is read as a double click

quirks.bug: intermediate position reported/applied inverted (requested 80% gives ~20%); DP1 open/stop/close direction is correct, so the motor-reverse setting is not a fix
quirks.workaround: implemented, parked (enabled=false): invert position only (100 - x, RX and TX) via the existing cover _invertedPosition path; DP1 untouched. Users can already enable the per-device invert_position setting
quirks.enableWhen: Homey diagnostic or user confirmation on the current app (historical report from the old app only; other firmware of this id may report correctly)

quirks.bug: warm and cold white reversed (setting warm gives cold and vice versa); RGB not settable (no cluster detail)
quirks.workaround: implemented, parked (enabled=false): light_temperature mapped 1 - x on TX and RX (TuyaZigBeeLightDevice). pid not reported in the source, so the record matches the manufacturer name only. RGB issue not addressed (no data)
quirks.enableWhen: second source or user confirmation with a diagnostic (single old report, no pid)

quirks.bug: temperature DP reported in raw °C instead of the usual ×10 scaling
quirks.workaround: already handled: per-manufacturer temperature parser returns the value unscaled

quirks.bug: radar motion reported inverted (on when leaving, off when entering) under another app's DP mapping
quirks.workaround: not applied: our layout reads presence from DP105 (enum) and that report concerns a different mapping; the inverted DP for our layout is unconfirmed (never guess a DP). Generic enum_remap / invert_bool_dp are available once a diagnostic on this app shows the polarity

quirks.bug: DP101 find_switch OFF → lux may still stream but distance (DP9) stays null/0 forever
quirks.workaround: auto-enable DP101 find_switch on boot/poll/cold-stream/stuck-zero (enableFindSwitchOnBoot)

quirks.bug: DP10 is not illuminance on ZY-M100-24GV3; treating it as lux paints junk (often lux=1) and kills real DP103 updates
quirks.workaround: map lux from DP103 only; DP10 kept as internal compat and skipped for ceiling 24G paint

quirks.bug: no relay — Homey may keep onoff / button.1 tiles that throw Missing capability Listener
quirks.workaround: strip onoff/button phantoms + soft no-op listeners until strip lands; compose capabilities exclude them
